incidents-bot: ALERT: serving-runtime | multiple CUDA illegal memory access errors observed on gpu-pool-ivory (rwd-gpu-a). Severity: P2. Trigger: 5 container crashes and 3 OOM kills in last 4m. Auto-scaling suspended for pool.

Alex G: Observed repeated kernel logs with 'misaligned address' and 'device addr fault' right before container exit. Looks like it spikes when batch_size > 32.

Maria S: I'm putting r4g-27 into cordon & drain now, taking traffic out of pool. Running: `kubectl cordon r4g-27 && kubectl drain r4g-27 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`

ops-bot: r4g-27 cordoned at 1765432135. Drain started, 4 pods evicted.

Alex G: Stack snippet from kubelet logs on r4g-27:
```
[ 1234.567890] compute: cuda: illegal memory access at pc=0x7f4a2c... pid=23211
[ 1234.567895] misaligned address: va=0x7f8b12 offset 0x40
[ 1234.567900] runtime: panic - GPU driver reported illegal_access
```

Tilly (oncall): I'm oncall, taking lead. @Jun K can you join? I want a quick repro vector and a mitigation plan.

Jun K (eng-runtime): joining. Early hypothesis: a kernel-level race in our custom mmap path when large KV cache pages are pinned during reload. Might be triggered by concurrent compaction + big-batch decode.

Jun K (eng-runtime): Quick mitigation options: 1) temporary throttle max-batch-size to 16 for affected pool; 2) route new requests to cpu-fallback pool for noisy customers; 3) roll back recent runtime bump that touched buffer pinning (deployed ~2h ago).

Lin C (customer-success): Customers A-Prod and B-Gen reported increased 5xxs ~12:34 UTC. A-Prod saw ~6% error rate, B-Gen ~3%. No data exfiltration reported. CS will message affected customers with ETA once we have a mitigation.

Tilly (oncall): Action plan: Maria + infra will cordon/drain (in progress), Jun + Alex will throttle batching at the LB layer, ops will enable cpu-fallback routing for high-risk tenants. If that stabilizes, we avoid rollback. If not, we do a targeted rollback.

Maria S: r4g-27 drained, marked unschedulable. Evacuation finished at 1765432198.

Alex G: Pushed a temporary batch cap to gateway rules for pool=ivory: `max_batch_size: 16` and lowered concurrency limit from 64 -> 32. Applied at 1765432210.

ops-bot: Gateway rule updated for pool=ivory at 1765432211. Routing change: noisy-tenants -> cpu-fallback-pool.

Jun K (eng-runtime): After throttling, error rate dropped by ~80% in internal spikes. Still seeing isolated illegal access on new nodes but much rarer. Running diagnostics on full memory traces; collecting vmcore and dmesg from r4g-28.

Alex G: Collected /var/log/kern.log + nvml dump from r4g-28 and uploaded to s3://redwood-incidents/1765432100/traces.tar.gz

Tilly (oncall): Good. Lin please send a brief to the affected customers that we've applied mitigations and are monitoring; ETA for next update in 30m.

Lin C (customer-success): Drafted message: "We've observed transient GPU errors causing request failures. We've applied throttles and routing workarounds; traffic should be stable. We'll follow up with root cause and timeline for fix." Ready to send on your go.

Jun K (eng-runtime): Next steps for root cause: 1) repro in staging with workload that does compaction + large batches; 2) run with buffer-pinning debug flags and ASAN-like checks; 3) if repro, prepare patch to avoid concurrent free/pin path. Could take 24-48h.

Tilly (oncall): For now, keep cpu-fallback enabled and gating max_batch_size. If we see any customer regressions, escalate immediately. I'll create follow-up ticket INC-2026-0421 and assign to eng-runtime + infra + oncall.

ops-bot: INC-2026-0421 created, assigned to Jun K and Maria S.

Alex G: Note: we observed one container restarted with OOM+illegal_access sequence (OOM inside GPU process then kernel report). Might be correlated to memory reuse after crash — keeping an eye.

Maria S: Re-enabling auto-scaling for pool=ivory with conservative limits in 10m to test stability.

Tilly (oncall): Plan accepted. Monitoring dashboards show 95th latency and error rate returning to baseline. Will keep thread open for final RCA. Marking severity to P3 at 1765432420 unless we regress. :white_check_mark:

incidents-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied (batch-throttle, cpu-fallback, cordon/drain). Monitoring.

Lin C (customer-success): Sending customer update now.

Jun K (eng-runtime): I'll start the staging repro and post logs in this thread once I have them.

Alex G: Thx team. Logging all artifacts to the incident bucket and adding notes to INC-2026-0421.

ops-bot: Thread auto-closed for alerts at 1765432420 (monitoring).
